description: C25 — 后是后盾，不是独行侠

intro.popup_en: Piece Coordination, Lesson 4: The queen should support the army, not act alone. Develop the minor pieces first, then bring the queen out from behind to coordinate them.
intro.popup:
子力协调第4课
王后的正确角色：后盾，不是独行侠
轻子先占位，后最后出动，在后方统筹协调

outro.popup_en: Develop the minor pieces first and use the queen as a supporting piece. Qe2 is an excellent coordinating square: it connects the rooks and supports the center.
outro.popup:
总结：轻子先行、后作后盾是协调的铁律
Qe2是后的最佳协调位置——连接双车、支援中路

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center.
moves.popup: e4占中心

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central move.
moves.popup: e5对称

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops White's first knight and controls d5, e4, and b5. Develop minor pieces first; keep the queen at home.
moves.popup:
Nc3第1个马出动！
激活：马出动控制中心格
协调：Nc3控d5/e4/b5
⚠️ 注意：轻子先行，后绝不出动！

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6黑方马出动
攻击e4

moves.popup_en: Bc4 develops the bishop, targets f7, and controls the d5 diagonal. Together with Nc3 it creates pressure, while the queen stays on d1 as a supporting piece.
moves.popup:
Bc4象出动！
激活：象瞄准f7，同时控制d5斜线
协调：Bc4+Nc3形成双子压制
计划：此时后在d1安心当后盾

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's second knight and protects e5.
moves.popup:
Nc6黑方第2马出动
保护e5

moves.popup_en: d3 develops steadily and opens the diagonal for White's c1-bishop. This Vienna setup waits to develop the queen until the minor pieces are ready.
moves.popup:
d3稳健推进
激活：开放c1象的斜线
计划：维也纳稳健体系——轻子全出后再出后

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 develops and targets f2 and b4.
moves.popup:
Bc5黑方象出动
瞄准f2/b4

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops White's second knight. Nc3 and Nf3 coordinate to control d4 and e5; the queen remains on d1 until the minor pieces are developed.
moves.popup:
Nf3第2个马出动！
激活：第3枚轻子上场
协调：Nc3+Nf3双马联控d4/e5
⚠️ 后仍在d1，继续等待！
规律：轻子没出齐，后绝不出动

moves.popup_en: ...d6 reinforces Black's center.
moves.popup: d6黑方守主

moves.popup_en: Be3 develops White's fourth minor piece and complements Bc4 by covering different diagonals. The queen's turn will come once development is complete.
moves.popup:
Be3第4枚轻子出动！
激活：c1象出动，守护d4/f4格
协调：Bc4+Be3（两象互补，覆盖两种斜线）
计划：轻子即将全出，后的出场时机将至

moves.popup_en: ...Bxe3 exchanges Black's bishop for the bishop on e3, trying to disrupt White's coordination.
moves.popup:
Bxe3黑方换象
黑方以Bc5换掉Be3
黑方试图破坏白方协调

moves.popup_en: fxe3 recaptures and opens the f-file for a rook. After castling, the rooks can become active on the e- and f-files.
moves.popup:
fxe3！f兵回吃
激活：开放f列！Rf1可进入游戏
协调：fxe3后f列半开，Re1/Rf1可激活
计划：易位后双车全部激活

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.
moves.popup:
O-O黑方易位
黑方国王入安全区

moves.popup_en: O-O! White activates the rook on f1 and coordinates four pieces: Bc4, Nc3, Nf3, and Rf1. With the minor pieces ready, the queen can now join.
moves.popup:
O-O白方易位！
激活：Rf1激活，加入协调阵列
协调：Bc4+Nc3+Nf3+Rf1四子联动
✅ 所有轻子就位，是后出场的信号！

moves.popup_en: ...Na5 attacks the bishop on c4 and prepares to exchange it.
moves.popup:
Na5黑方马攻击Bc4
黑方准备换掉白方象

moves.popup_en: Bb3 retreats to a stable square on the a2-g8 diagonal and avoids the knight's exchange attempt.
moves.popup:
Bb3象主动撤退
激活：Bb3控制a2-g8斜线
协调：Bb3位置稳固，不怕被Na5换掉

moves.popup_en: ...Nxb3 exchanges Black's knight for White's bishop.
moves.popup:
Nxb3黑方换象
黑方换掉白方象

moves.popup_en: axb3 recaptures, opens the a-file, and gives White's rook a possible route forward.
moves.popup:
axb3a兵回吃
激活：a列半开放
协调：Ra1可向前推进

moves.popup_en: ...Be6 develops Black's final minor piece.
moves.popup:
Be6黑方象出动
黑方轻子发展完成

moves.popup_en: Re1! White controls the e-file and coordinates the rook with Nc3 and Nf3. With the file controlled, the queen is ready to act.
moves.popup:
Re1！车激活！
激活：Re1控制e列
协调：Re1+Nc3+Nf3三子联动控中心
计划：e列已由Re1控制，后的出场时机到了！

moves.popup_en: ...Re8 activates Black's rook to contest the e-file.
moves.popup:
Re8黑方车激活
黑方车也进e列争夺

moves.popup_en: Qe2!! The queen joins last and coordinates the whole position: it supports Re1 on the e-file, connects both rooks, and helps Nc3 and Nf3 defend the center. This is the queen's ideal supporting role. The sequence confirms the rule: develop the knights and bishops first, then bring out the queen.
moves.popup:
Qe2！！后最后出场！
激活：后在e2，统筹全局
协调：Qe2的任务分工
  ♛ 支援Re1控制e列
  ♛ 连接Ra1+Re1双车
  ♛ 支援Nc3+Nf3守中心
✅ 后在e2是后盾的最佳位置！

铁律验证：
第2步马→第3步象→第5步马→第6步象
全部就位后，第12步后才出场！
